reason: Plan step added a second accessibility service next to the Onn monitor by appending to enabled_accessibility_services; on the real box Android cleared the whole list and unbound the monitor for ~10-20 s (coverage gap, restored by IT, found by the 2026-11-17 spike). No rule covers a plan step that edits device enable state. Proposed rule: any step that changes the monitor enabled state names its restore path, a read-back check, and how a gap is disclosed to Dad.

Names the false case (watcher wake reported before main's first alive beat, seen 2026-11-20 08:48) and ships a test where a wake 200s and 3600s old with main still asleep still emails; the 30s and 170s cases are quiet.
The grace delays the fake-asleep email by up to 3 minutes (plus the 1-minute cron). Not removed or muted, same recipients and sender; PR is marked REDUCES COVERAGE and waits for Jonah and Dad.

eg_check_gone_dark has 16 committed versions and later patches rewrite live text; the SQL patches the live definition and aborts unless the target line occurs exactly once, with a test that an unknown live function is left unchanged.

Names the false case (iOS-suspended idle tunnel, Jada's dark email every ~30 min, router dark-context shows wg quiet 168s, not on LAN). Tests: no Find My data, stale Find My (25m, 2h), stale report (30m) and explicit-site flags still email; only 'seen <=20m and report fresh' is quiet.

Suppresses one email (quick 'went dark') while Find My saw the phone within 20 minutes; sustained-dark (10 min) and MONITOR-offline emails untouched, so a phone on but unmonitored still alerts. PR is marked REDUCES COVERAGE; data is self-reported (tamper-evident, same as Jonah's existing check).

Trigger function patched in place from the live text with exactly-once guards on three lines (aborts and changes nothing otherwise); test proves an unknown live function is refused and a re-run is a no-op.

New anon-callable RPC mirrors Jonah's eg_report_findmy_status; future timestamps (>5m) ignored so the alert cannot be pre-silenced; Find My device match needs two words so another family member's phone never matches.
Only --setup (interactive, never cron --once) is changed; it now refuses to run from a non-installed copy of the code. No alert, check or detection path changes; coverage untouched.
Pure-function test for the tree check (installed, symlinked, stale, no installed tree) plus source-order checks that the refusal comes before config load and the password prompt.

Operator steps given in chat told the user to cd into the home copy of the code for --setup; the installed root-owned tree is the real one. Proposed rule: any operator command that runs repo code names the tree it must run from and a read-back that proves the effect (marker gone, setup record updated).

Delays secondary 'monitor went quiet' emails by up to 10 minutes after the first one in a pile-up; nothing is dropped, content preserved in a digest, first alert immediate. PR is marked REDUCES COVERAGE and needs Dad's review. Mac, phone-dark, content, tamper, unmonitored and G11 emails are never held (tested).
Wrappers patched in place from the live text with exactly-once guards; refuses if the labelling wrapper is absent; re-run is a no-op.

Fail-open gate (any gate error sends the email at once), held items released by the minute job, by the next email through any sender, and after 15 minutes regardless; a failed send keeps items held for retry. Each tested, plus a documented one-statement rollback.

MDM unreachable alert judged by app-list age only, so a locked phone that connected on every push was called unreachable then reachable 2 s later (7 pairs on Nov 22). Proposed rule: a reachability alert must test the same signal its recovery event uses.

FreeTube (a YouTube client) never matched the youtube low-risk discount because its title has no youtube; 3 CLIP reds 0.73-0.84 emailed on Nov 24. Proposed rule: low-risk context lists name every client for a covered service, with a test.

Router stall tamper alert (Nov 22 03:47, 977s lag vs 900s limit) carried no evidence to tell AdGuard batching from a stopped log; added numbers-only diagnostic. Proposed rule: a tamper alert that can be a timing artifact must carry the timing evidence.

Find My death was unrecorded: no line for the last good cycle or session age; added a per-cycle trace. Proposed rule: any watcher that can silently lose a credential logs last-good-cycle and credential age.

MDM poller waited 30 min before re-queuing an unanswered app-list command even while the phone connected on every push (Nov 22: no new app-list command 20:15-20:45); re-queue after 10 min when contact is seen. Proposed rule: a retry timer must shorten when the peer shows signs of life.

First draft of the exemption SQL opened an incident kind the incident log did not accept; the SQL test caught it. Proposed rule: any new incident kind or status value ships with the constraint widening and a test that opens it.

Viewer changes had no runnable WebCrypto test on the Mac (no node). Added tools/title_viewer_firefox_test.py (Firefox over Marionette). Proposed rule: a browser-crypto change ships with a test that runs in a real browser engine, not only node.

MediaFactsTest had raw non-ASCII literals and failed to compile in IT container (LC_ALL=C); IT found it. Test now uses \u escapes. Proposed rule: JVM tests that run in the build container must be pure ASCII.

Battery inference (#187) only covered the quick dark email with a 30-minute window; the MDM unreachable email is sent 30+ min after the last reading by design so it never qualified. Proposed rule: a wording hook must be checked against every email that can describe the same event, with that email's own timing.
